He folded the note into his coat pocket and climbed the stairs to relight the lamp, because someone, somewhere, might still be looking for a way home.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市褪去了白昼的喧嚣，只剩路灯在雾气中晕开昏黄的光。写字楼里零星几扇窗还亮着，像不眠者的眼睛。远处高架桥上偶尔驶过一辆货车，轮胎碾过接缝的声音被空旷的街道放大。便利店的灯牌在转角处孤零零地闪烁，玻璃门上贴着过期的促销海报。一只野猫从花坛里探出头，竖起耳朵，又缩回黑暗。天空还是深蓝色的，但东方已有一丝极淡的灰白，像宣纸上洇开的墨。这座城市在睡着，也没有全睡着——它只是在换气，等着第一班地铁唤醒它。", "w03": "• Imagine you're standing between two mirrors that face each other—you see yourself, then yourself inside that reflection, then inside that one, going on forever.\n• Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem, like opening a Russian nesting doll to find a slightly smaller doll inside.\n• Eventually you reach the smallest doll that doesn't open—that's the \"base case,\" and that's what stops the recursion from going on forever."}
